title: Produce reproducible RigorLoop product candidates
description: Product maintainers can produce and inspect faithful supported skill archives and a complete executable CLI package and reusable architecture browser resources with attributable metadata, reproducible declared contents, and actual packed-consumer qualification. The capability preserves authored meaning while separating candidate production from installation and public release.

includes: Canonical-source and declared-target generation with complete resources and faithful transformations.
Isolated deterministic candidate output and factual artifact integrity metadata.
Actual CLI package content and clean-consumer assessment with observed scope.
Actual browser-candidate resource completeness and independent customer generation/offline-reading qualification.
excludes: Installing into active user roots as a build side effect.
Adding agent targets, altering public behavior, or publishing without the relevant reviewed decisions.
Treating generated expectations as executed proof.
